```{r echo = T, results = 'hide', message=FALSE}
source('functions_adwm.R')
```

## Read in data
```{r}
exp2_dt <- read_dt('./exp2_data')

exp2_dt <- exp2_dt[presentation_time != 20]

exp2_dt[prev_duration %in% c(50) &
         prev_duration2 %in% c(50),
         prev_duration_cat := 50]

exp2_dt[prev_duration %in% c(200) &
         prev_duration2 %in% c(200),
         prev_duration_cat := 200]

exp2_dt[prev_duration %in% c(400) &
         prev_duration2 %in% c(400),
       prev_duration_cat := 400]

# remove first three trials in each block for perfect n-1 and n-2 counterbalancing
exp2_dt <- exp2_dt[db_counter > 3]
```

## Density plot
```{r}
dplot <- ggplot(exp2_dt, 
                aes(x=error_angle, 
                    group=as.factor(presentation_time),
                    color=as.factor(presentation_time))) +
  geom_density(size=1.5) +
  scale_colour_grey(start = 0.75, end = 0., 
                    name='Presentation\ntime (ms)') +
  scale_x_continuous(name='Error Angle (rad)', 
                     limits=c(-pi, pi),
                     breaks=c(-pi, 0, pi),
                     labels=c(expression(-pi), 0, expression(pi))) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.6, 0.7))

dplot
#ggsave('exp2_dplot.png', dplot, dpi=600, width=4, height=3)
```

## Effect of N-1
```{r}
exp2_n1_summary_dt <- fit_encoding_rc(exp2_dt, 
                                  c('prev_duration'))
```

### Encoding curves
```{r}
color_indices <- c(1,3,4)
plot_colours <- brewer.pal(max(color_indices), 'RdBu')[color_indices]

exp2_encoding_plot_n1 <- plot_encoding_rc(exp2_n1_summary_dt$summary_dt, 
                 c('prev_duration'), 
                 color_indices=c(1,3,4), exp2_n1_summary_dt$rc_fit)

exp2_encoding_plot_n1 <- exp2_encoding_plot_n1 +
  scale_colour_manual(values=plot_colours,
                      name=expression(
                        paste('n-1 presentation time')))

exp2_encoding_plot_n1
#ggsave('exp2_encoding_curves_n1.svg', width = 5, height = 3)
#ggsave('exp2_encoding_curves_n1.png', dpi=500, width = 5, height = 3)
```

### Plot parameters
```{r}
exp2_parplot_n1 <- plot_parameter_summary(exp2_n1_summary_dt$rc_fit,
                       c('prev_duration'),
                                           color_indices=c(1,3,4))

x_axis <- ggdraw() +
  draw_label(expression(paste('n-1 presentation time (ms)')))


exp2_parplot_n1 <- exp2_parplot_n1 / x_axis +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2), height=c(1, 0.1))

exp2_parplot_n1
#ggsave('exp2_parplot_n1.png', dpi=500, width=6, height=3)
```

```{r}
# create full plot with both encoding curve and par. estimates
exp2_n1_fullplot <- exp2_encoding_plot_n1 / exp2_parplot_n1
ggsave('exp2_n1_fullplot.png', width=5, height=6, dpi=500)
ggsave('exp2_n1_fullplot.tiff',
       plot = exp2_n1_fullplot,
       width=5, height=6, dpi=500)

```

### Statistical analysis
```{r}
# Encoding speed
rc_data <- exp2_n1_summary_dt$rc_fit

exp2_n1_lm0 <- lm(rate_ratio ~ c_ratio,
                    rc_data)
exp2_n1_lm1 <- lm(rate_ratio ~ c_ratio + prev_duration,
                    rc_data)

summary(exp2_n1_lm1)
BIC(exp2_n1_lm0, exp2_n1_lm1)
BIC(exp2_n1_lm0) - BIC(exp2_n1_lm1)
exp((BIC(exp2_n1_lm0) - BIC(exp2_n1_lm1))/2)
```

```{r}
# Capacity
rc_data <- exp2_n1_summary_dt$rc_fit
exp2_n1_capacity_lm0 <- lm(c_ratio ~ rate_ratio,
                    rc_data)
exp2_n1_capacity_lm1 <- lm(c_ratio ~ rate_ratio + prev_duration,
                    rc_data)

summary(exp2_n1_capacity_lm1)
BIC(exp2_n1_capacity_lm0, exp2_n1_capacity_lm1)
BIC(exp2_n1_capacity_lm0) - BIC(exp2_n1_capacity_lm1)
exp((BIC(exp2_n1_capacity_lm0) - BIC(exp2_n1_capacity_lm1))/2)
```

## Effect of N-1+2
```{r}
exp2_n12_summary_dt <- fit_encoding_rc(exp2_dt, 
                                        c('prev_duration_cat'))
```

### Encoding Curves
```{r}
color_indices <- c(1,3,4)
plot_colours <- brewer.pal(max(color_indices), 'RdBu')[color_indices]

exp2_encoding_plot_n12 <- plot_encoding_rc(exp2_n12_summary_dt$summary_dt, 
                 c('prev_duration_cat'), 
                 color_indices=c(1,3,4), exp2_n12_summary_dt$rc_fit)

exp2_encoding_plot_n12 <- exp2_encoding_plot_n12 +
  scale_colour_manual(values=plot_colours,
                      name=expression(
                        paste('n-1 and n-2 presentation time')))

exp2_encoding_plot_n12
#ggsave('exp2_encoding_curves_n12.svg', width = 5, height = 3)
#ggsave('exp2_encoding_curves_n12.png', dpi=500, width = 5, height = 3)
```
### Plot parameters
```{r}
exp2_parplot_n12 <- plot_parameter_summary(exp2_n12_summary_dt$rc_fit, 
                       c('prev_duration_cat'),
                       color_indices=c(1,3,4))

x_axis <- ggdraw() +
  draw_label(expression(paste('n-1 and n-2 presentation time')))

exp2_parplot_n12 <- exp2_parplot_n12 / x_axis +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2), height=c(1, 0.1))

exp2_parplot_n12
#ggsave('exp2_parplot_n12.png', dpi=500, width=6, height=3)
```

```{r}
# average magnitude of the speedup
setkey(exp2_n12_summary_dt$rc_fit, 'subject_nr', 'prev_duration_cat')
median(exp2_n12_summary_dt$rc_fit[prev_duration_cat==50, rate] / exp2_n12_summary_dt$rc_fit[prev_duration_cat==400, rate])
```

```{r}
# create full plot with both encoding curve and par. estimates
exp2_n12_fullplot <- exp2_encoding_plot_n12 / exp2_parplot_n12
ggsave('exp2_n12_fullplot.png', width=5, height=6, dpi=500)
ggsave('exp2_n12_fullplot.tiff', 
       plot = exp2_n12_fullplot,
       width=5, height=6, dpi=500)

```

### Statistical Analysis
```{r}
# Encoding Speed
rc_data <- exp2_n12_summary_dt$rc_fit
exp2_n12_lm0 <- lm(rate_ratio ~ c_ratio,
                    rc_data)
exp2_n12_lm1 <- lm(rate_ratio ~ c_ratio + prev_duration_cat,
                    rc_data)

summary(exp2_n12_lm1)
BIC(exp2_n12_lm0, exp2_n12_lm1)
BIC(exp2_n12_lm0) - BIC(exp2_n12_lm1)
exp((BIC(exp2_n12_lm0) - BIC(exp2_n12_lm1))/2)
```

```{r}
# Capacity
rc_data <- exp2_n12_summary_dt$rc_fit
exp2_n12_capacity_lm0 <- lm(c_ratio ~ rate_ratio,
                    rc_data)
exp2_n12_capacity_lm1 <- lm(c_ratio ~ rate_ratio + prev_duration_cat,
                    rc_data)

summary(exp2_n12_capacity_lm1)
BIC(exp2_n12_capacity_lm0, exp2_n12_capacity_lm1)
BIC(exp2_n12_capacity_lm0) - BIC(exp2_n12_capacity_lm1)
exp((BIC(exp2_n12_capacity_lm0) - BIC(exp2_n12_capacity_lm1))/2)
```

### Slope comparison: Are the slopes for n-1 vs. n-1 and n-2 different?
```{r}
b_n1 <- exp2_n1_lm1$coefficients[[3]]
se_n1 <- coef(summary(exp2_n1_lm1))[, "Std. Error"][[3]]

b_n12 <- exp2_n12_lm1$coefficients[[3]]
se_n12 <- coef(summary(exp2_n12_lm1))[, "Std. Error"][[3]]

z_exp2 <- (b_n12 - b_n1) /  (sqrt(se_n12**2 + se_n1**2))
z_exp2

p_slopes_exp2 <- pnorm(z_exp2)
p_slopes_exp2
```

## N-1 foreperiod
```{r}
exp2_dt[, prev_fp_short := prev_fp < median(prev_fp),
        by = c('subject_nr', 'presentation_time', 'prev_duration')]
```

```{r}
exp2_fp_summary_dt <- fit_encoding_rc(exp2_dt, 
                      c('prev_duration', 'prev_fp_short'))
```

### Encoding Curves
```{r}
color_indices <- c(4, 1)
plot_colours <- brewer.pal(max(color_indices), 'RdBu')[color_indices]

exp2_encoding_plot_fp <- plot_encoding_rc(exp2_fp_summary_dt$summary_dt, 
                 c('prev_fp_short'), 
                 color_indices=c(4, 1), 
                 exp2_fp_summary_dt$rc_fit)

exp2_encoding_plot_fp <- exp2_encoding_plot_fp +
  scale_colour_manual(values=plot_colours, 
                      labels = c('Long', 'Short'),
                      name=expression(
                        paste('n-1 foreperiod')))

exp2_encoding_plot_fp
#ggsave('exp2_encoding_curves_fp.png', dpi=500, width = 5, height = 3)
```

### Plot parameters
```{r}
exp2_parplot_fp <- plot_parameter_summary(exp2_fp_summary_dt$rc_fit,
                       c('prev_fp_short'),
                       color_indices=c(4, 1))

x_axis <- ggdraw() +
  draw_label(expression(paste('n-1 foreperiod')))

exp2_parplot_fp <- exp2_parplot_fp &
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c('Long', 'Short'))

exp2_parplot_fp <- exp2_parplot_fp / x_axis +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2), height=c(1, 0.1))

exp2_parplot_fp
#ggsave('exp2_parplot_fp.png', dpi=500, width=6, height=3)
```

```{r}
# create full plot with both encoding curve and par. estimates
exp2_fp_fullplot <- exp2_encoding_plot_fp / exp2_parplot_fp
ggsave('exp2_fp_fullplot.png', width=5, height=6, dpi=500)
ggsave('exp2_fp_fullplot.tiff', 
       plot = exp2_fp_fullplot,
       width=5, height=6, dpi=500)

```

### Statistical comparison
```{r}
rc_data <- exp2_fp_summary_dt$rc_fit
exp2_fp_lm0 <- lm(rate_ratio ~ c_ratio,
                    rc_data)
exp2_fp_lm1 <- lm(rate_ratio ~ c_ratio + prev_duration,
                    rc_data)
exp2_fp_lm2 <- lm(rate_ratio ~ c_ratio + prev_fp_short,
                    rc_data)
exp2_fp_lm3 <- lm(rate_ratio ~ c_ratio + prev_duration + prev_fp_short,
                    rc_data)
exp2_fp_lm4 <- lm(rate_ratio ~ c_ratio + prev_duration * prev_fp_short,
                    rc_data)

summary(exp2_fp_lm3)
summary(exp2_fp_lm4)

BIC(exp2_fp_lm0, exp2_fp_lm1, 
    exp2_fp_lm2, exp2_fp_lm3, exp2_fp_lm4)

BIC(exp2_fp_lm1) - BIC(exp2_fp_lm3)
BIC(exp2_fp_lm3) - BIC(exp2_fp_lm4)
BIC(exp2_fp_lm2) - BIC(exp2_fp_lm3)
  
exp((BIC(exp2_fp_lm1) - BIC(exp2_fp_lm3))/2)
exp((BIC(exp2_fp_lm3) - BIC(exp2_fp_lm4))/2)
exp((BIC(exp2_fp_lm2) - BIC(exp2_fp_lm3))/2)

```

## N-1 error-corrections
```{r}
exp2_dt[, median_error := median(abs(prev_error)), 
         by=c('subject_nr', 'prev_duration', 'presentation_time')]
exp2_dt[abs(prev_error) > median_error, prev_error_large := TRUE]
exp2_dt[abs(prev_error) < median_error, prev_error_large := FALSE]

```

```{r}
exp2_error_summary_dt <- fit_encoding_rc(
  exp2_dt[!is.na(prev_error_large)], 
                      c('prev_duration', 'prev_error_large'))
```

### Encoding Curves
```{r}
color_indices <- c(4, 1)
plot_colours <- brewer.pal(max(color_indices), 'RdBu')[color_indices]

exp2_encoding_plot_error <- plot_encoding_rc(exp2_error_summary_dt$summary_dt, 
                 c('prev_error_large'), 
                 color_indices=c(4, 1), 
                 exp2_error_summary_dt$rc_fit)

exp2_encoding_plot_error <- exp2_encoding_plot_error +
  scale_colour_manual(values=plot_colours, 
                      labels = c('Small', 'Large'),
                      name=expression(
                        paste('n-1 error')))

exp2_encoding_plot_error
ggsave('exp2_encoding_curves_error.png', dpi=500, width = 5, height = 3)
```

### Plot parameters
```{r}
exp2_parplot_error <- plot_parameter_summary(exp2_error_summary_dt$rc_fit,
                       c('prev_error_large'),
                       color_indices=c(4, 1))

x_axis <- ggdraw() +
  draw_label(expression(paste('n-1 error')))

exp2_parplot_error <- exp2_parplot_error &
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c('Small', 'Large'))

exp2_parplot_error <- exp2_parplot_error / x_axis +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2), height=c(1, 0.1))

exp2_parplot_error
ggsave('exp2_parplot_error.png', dpi=500, width=6, height=3)
```

```{r}
# create full plot with both encoding curve and par. estimates
exp2_error_fullplot <- exp2_encoding_plot_error / exp2_parplot_error
ggsave('exp2_error_fullplot.png', width=5, height=6, dpi=500)
ggsave('exp2_error_fullplot.tiff', 
       plot = exp2_error_fullplot,
       width=5, height=6, dpi=500)

```

### Statistical Comparison
```{r}
rc_data <- exp2_error_summary_dt$rc_fit
exp2_error_lm0 <- lm(rate_ratio ~ c_ratio,
                    rc_data)
exp2_error_lm1 <- lm(rate_ratio ~ c_ratio + prev_duration,
                    rc_data)
exp2_error_lm2 <- lm(rate_ratio ~ c_ratio + prev_error_large,
                    rc_data)
exp2_error_lm3 <- lm(rate_ratio ~ c_ratio + 
                       prev_duration + prev_error_large,
                    rc_data)
exp2_error_lm4 <- lm(rate_ratio ~ c_ratio + 
                       prev_duration * prev_error_large,
                    rc_data)

summary(exp2_error_lm3)
BIC(exp2_error_lm0, exp2_error_lm1, 
    exp2_error_lm2, exp2_error_lm3, exp2_error_lm4)
BIC(exp2_error_lm1) - BIC(exp2_error_lm3)
exp((BIC(exp2_error_lm1) - BIC(exp2_error_lm3))/2)
```
